newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI up 7.50 pct at 172 pesos in late trade.
newsitem.headline: BPI up 7.50 pct at 172 pesos in late trade.

text.p: BPI gained 12 pesos, or 7.50 percent, to 172 pesos in late trade on Friday on news the government had approved a request to let foreigners raise their stake in the bank to up to 40 percent from 30 percent at present, brokers said.
"It's a combination of positive developments. Foremost is that the foreign ownership cap of the bank has been raised," said a trader from one foreign brokerage house.
One broker said that Standard & Poors Corp's favorable rating of BPI also boosted the stock.
The stock has risen consistently since last Tuesday when news that S&P rated the bank triple B triggered buying. The stock was at 146 pesos on the previous day.
BPI's request to the government to allow foreign portfolio investors to raise their stake to up to 40 percent was approved on November 25. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
